info.name: Clear Street Trading Omni AI API

items.docs: List current signable entitlement agreements for consent UX.
Record consent and upsert one-or-more active grants.
Revoke one entitlement grant by id.

Get a finalized message by ID.

Returns a single finalized message. Returns **404** if the message belongs
to an in-progress assistant turn (use the response endpoint for live
output). Once the turn completes, the message becomes available here.

Submit feedback on a finalized assistant message.

Attaches a score and optional comment to a finalized assistant message.
Feedback is only valid for messages with role `ASSISTANT` that have
reached a terminal outcome.

Poll a response for assistant output.

Returns the current snapshot of an in-progress or completed response.
While the status is `queued` or `running`, the content may be partial and
may include `thinking` parts. Poll this endpoint periodically until the
status reaches a terminal value (`succeeded`, `failed`, or `canceled`).

Once terminal, the finalized assistant message is available in thread
history via `GET /omni-ai/threads/{thread_id}/messages`.

Cancel a response.

Requests cancellation of a queued or running response. If the response has
already reached a terminal status, this is an idempotent success. A
canceled turn still produces a final assistant message with outcome
`canceled` in the thread history.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of items to return per page. Only used when page_token is not provided.

params.name: page_token
params.description: Token for retrieving the next or previous page of results. Contains encoded pagination state; when provided, page_size is ignored.

items.docs:
List conversation threads.

Returns thread metadata ordered by most recently created first. Use
`page_size` and `page_token` for pagination. Thread objects contain only
metadata (title, timestamps) — use the messages endpoint for conversation
history.

Create a new conversation thread.

Atomically creates a new thread and submits the first user turn. The
response contains a `response_id` that should be polled via
`GET /omni-ai/responses/{response_id}` for assistant output.

Two creation modes are supported:
- **instant** — provide `text` with a natural-language prompt.
- **deep_insights** — provide a `target` ticker and optional `thesis`
  for long-form research.

Get a specific thread.

Returns metadata (title, timestamps) for a single thread. Does not include
messages — use `GET /omni-ai/threads/{thread_id}/messages` for conversation
history.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of items to return per page. Only used when page_token is not provided.

params.name: page_token
params.description: Token for retrieving the next or previous page of results. Contains encoded pagination state; when provided, page_size is ignored.

items.docs:
List finalized messages in a thread.

Returns the latest page of **finalized** messages by default, with messages
within each page ordered chronologically. Messages from in-progress
assistant turns are excluded — use
`GET /omni-ai/threads/{thread_id}/response` or
`GET /omni-ai/responses/{response_id}` for live output.

If the last finalized message has role `USER`, an active response likely
exists and should be polled separately.

Continue an existing conversation thread.

Appends a new user message to the thread and starts an assistant response.
Only one response may be active per thread at a time — if the previous turn
is still in progress, this endpoint returns **409 Conflict**. Wait for the
active response to reach a terminal status before submitting the next turn.

Poll the returned `response_id` via `GET /omni-ai/responses/{response_id}`
for assistant output.

params.name: thread_id
params.description: Thread to check for active response

items.docs:
Get the active response for a thread.

Convenience endpoint to look up the currently active response for a thread
without knowing the `response_id`. Useful when reloading a thread whose
last finalized message is a `USER` message — this indicates an assistant
turn is likely in progress.

Returns **404** if no active response exists (the thread is idle).
